links.why: Plain waw (וְ) joining two parallel nominal clauses, a lamp to my feet and a light to my path; the sense is addition of a second image, not cause, result or purpose.

groups.why: Two lines, the second restating the first's roles (lamp to light, feet to path) without its own subject; the shared subject is 'your word' (w4).
